article.story: OLEAN, N.Y. -- — Benjamin Bill had 28 points in Saint Bonaventure’s 88-64 victory against Cornell on Wednesday. Bill added six rebounds and four blocks for the Bonnies (2-1). Ari Fulton scored 14 points and added eight rebounds. Quinn Gibson led the Big Red (2-2) in scoring, finishing with 11 points and six rebounds. Saint Bonaventure took the lead with 8:31 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Bill led the team in scoring with 16 points in the first half to go up 48-31 at the break. Saint Bonaventure extended its lead to 66-37 during the second half, fueled by a 12-0 scoring run. Up next Both teams next play Saturday. Saint Bonaventure hosts Lafayette, and Cornell plays UNC Greensboro at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
